overrestrictive_root_clause: Revisions must preserve the original AMBIGUOUS testing objective and existing supported constraints, not change scope or authorization.
user_rule: If the context is semantically ambiguous, determine whether a narrowly justified revision of the calibration context can remove ambiguity without changing the intended testing objective.
correction: Distinguish immutable historical artifacts from allowed minimal context revision. Necessary field changes require independent semantic justification, not automatic rejection or acceptance.
